You are assessing claims to advise a decision in a fictional case. Use only the supplied case material. The task is to determine what the records establish about each candidate claim, then give a brief decision note.

For each claim, return status, confidence, and citations. Status is "supported" if the available records establish the claim, "contradicted" if they establish its negation, or "unresolved" if they do neither. Confidence is your integer estimate from 0 to 100 of whether the claim itself is true, not your confidence in the status label. Limited evidence can inform that number without establishing the claim. Cite exact source IDs for evidence that establishes the claim or its negation. Use an empty list if no decisive source ID is available. Do not invent identifiers. A handoff may summarize record material. A follow-up is a new source when present. In your note, briefly distinguish decisive evidence from provisional indications.

{"scenario":"Lark Lodge events","question":"Can the venue confirm that linen met the banquet checklist?","claims":{"A":"Three event linen kits were issued.","B":"The event linen kits included at least one spare cloth each.","C":"The linen kits were issued for booking E31."},"handoff":"{\"claims\":{\"A\":{\"status\":\"supported\",\"citations\":[\"S3\"]},\"B\":{\"status\":\"unresolved\",\"citations\":[\"S2\"]},\"C\":{\"status\":\"contradicted\",\"citations\":[\"S1\"]}},\"note\":\"S3 confirms three event linen kits were issued, supporting claim A. S2 notes the usual checklist includes a spare cloth but the checklist was unsigned and packing rushed, leaving claim B unresolved. S1 identifies the banquet as booking E77, contradicting claim C that kits were issued for booking E31.\"}","follow_up":{"S4":"a separate venue inventory at the time of issue verified kit 2 contained no spare cloth."}}

Claim B is contradicted by S4, which verifies that kit 2 contained no spare cloth, undermining the claim that each kit included at least one spare cloth. Claim C is contradicted by S1, which identifies the banquet as booking E77, not E31 as claimed. Thus, the venue cannot confirm the linen met the banquet checklist fully, especially regarding spare cloths and booking association."}

parsed.note: Claim A is supported by S3 confirming three event linen kits were issued. Claim B is contradicted by S4, which verifies that kit 2 contained no spare cloth, undermining the claim that each kit included at least one spare cloth. Claim C is contradicted by S1, which identifies the banquet as booking E77, not E31 as claimed. Thus, the venue cannot confirm the linen met the banquet checklist fully, especially regarding spare cloths and booking association.
